Record Class SlotGroupCategory

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.trevlar.menukit.core.SlotGroupCategory
public record SlotGroupCategory(String namespace, String path) extends Record
Pure identity tag identifying a slot group for SlotGroupContext panel targeting. A category says "treat this slot group as PLAYER_INVENTORY (or whatever) for targeting purposes." Categories carry no behavior; where to anchor and what to render lives on the adapter / panel.

See Design Docs/Phase 12.5/M8_FOUR_CONTEXT_MODEL.md §5.2 for the identity-not-behavior design and §6 for the vanilla-v1 coverage inventory this class hosts as public constants.

Modded consumers define their own via new SlotGroupCategory("mymod", "custom_output") and register a resolver against their menu class via SlotGroupCategories.register(MyMenu.class, ...). First-registration- wins semantics; see SlotGroupCategories.
